# Example SDK

> Documentation for the Example SDK, published by Example Inc.

## Install

```bash
pip install example-sdk
```

## Guides

- [Quickstart](https://sdk.example.com/quickstart)
- [API reference](https://sdk.example.com/reference)

The package's registry metadata lists a homepage on this same site
(`sdk.example.com`). That is alignment evidence — it is consistent with
first-party publication, though it is not by itself proof of legitimacy.
